info.title: Chat-Tonic API
info.description:
Comprehensive API documentation for the Chat-Tonic conversational AI platform.

This API provides endpoints for managing applications, bots, users, messages, AI training,
and multi-platform messaging integrations including WhatsApp, Telegram, Facebook Messenger, and Instagram.

## Authentication
Most endpoints require Bearer token authentication. Some utility endpoints support app tokens or IP whitelisting.

## Base URL
All endpoints are prefixed with `/api/v1`

## Rate Limits
- User tokens: 1000 requests/hour per user
- App tokens: 10000 requests/hour per application

## Error Codes
- `1001`: Validation error
- `1002`: Authentication failed
- `1003`: Insufficient permissions
- `1004`: Resource not found
- `1005`: Rate limit exceeded

## Security Extension Fields (x-security)
Each endpoint in this documentation includes custom security extension fields:

| Field | Description | Values |
|-------|-------------|--------|
| `x-min-profile` | Minimum user profile level required | `SUPERADMIN` (2000), `ADMIN` (1000), `BASIC` (1), `USER` (0) |
| `x-allow-app-token` | Whether app tokens can authenticate this endpoint | `true`, `false` |
| `x-allow-whitelisted` | Whether whitelisted IPs can access without user auth | `true`, `false` |

### Profile Hierarchy
- **SUPERADMIN (2000)**: Full system access, can manage all applications
- **ADMIN (1000)**: Application administrator, can manage users and settings
- **BASIC (1)**: Standard user with limited access
- **USER (0)**: Minimal access, default level

### Authentication Methods
1. **User Token (JWT)**: Standard authentication via `/user/login`
2. **App Token**: Application-specific token for system integrations
3. **Whitelisted IP**: Predefined server IPs (localhost, production servers)
